turns.content: On night watch, I spot three pale lights bobbing along the ridge above camp. I nudge Brennic awake. "Look. Up there."

Brennic: *opens one copper eye, then both* "Lanterns. Or something pretending." *reaches for his knife* "Bandits don't usually announce themselves."
Tobbe: *sits up from his bedroll, eyes wide, rapping the wagon boards* "Marsh spirits. Grandmother said never look at them."
Mira: *already awake, spectacles on* "They are moving in a perfectly straight line, which is not what spirits or bandits would do, but is exactly what a party following a road would do."
"There's no road up there," I whisper. "Is there?"

Mira: "There is not one on any map I have, which is precisely why I would like to go and look."
Brennic: "No. You'd like to go and get your throat cut. Sit down."
Tobbe: *gently puts a huge hand on Mira's shoulder* "Stay. Please. Tobbe asks nicely."
The lights crest the ridge and vanish. I let out my breath. "Gone. We'll double the watch until dawn."

Brennic: "Double watch. Good. I'll take the next turn. Not sleeping now anyway."
Mira: *scribbling by the embers* "I am noting the time, the direction and the spacing of the lights, and tomorrow I intend to look for tracks."
Tobbe: *knocks the wagon wood three more times for good measure* "Tobbe will make tea. Tea helps."
